newsitem.title: USA: Specialized signs license, option pact.
newsitem.headline: Specialized signs license, option pact.

text.p: Specialized Health Products International Inc said Thursday that its Specialized Health Products unit signed a letter of intent to enter into a license and option agreement with Becton Dickinson and Co.
The agreement is to commercialize Specialized Health's ExtraSafe technology across Becton's Worldwide Infusion Therapy, Worldwide Sample Collection and Worldwide Injection Systems businesses.

The terms of the letter of intent define conditions for the first licensed application of the ExtraSafe technology, the company said. The first license agreement will provide up front payments of $2 million upon the signing of agreement and $2 million more no later than March 1998, the company said.
Specific terms and details of the agreement will not be disclosed, the company said.
